import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))
    
    max1 = max2 = float('-inf')
    min1 = min2 = float('inf')
    
    for num in arr:
        if num > max1:
            max2 = max1
            max1 = num
        elif num > max2:
            max2 = num
        
        if num < min1:
            min2 = min1
            min1 = num
        elif num < min2:
            min2 = num
    
    product1 = max1 * max2
    product2 = min1 * min2
    
    result = max(product1, product2)
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
